title: Add --json output flag to the stats CLI
prompt: Add a --json flag to cli.py so `python3 cli.py --json 3 1 4 1 5` prints the stats as a single-line JSON object with keys count, mean, min, max (mean as a float). Without --json the existing plain-text output must stay byte-for-byte identical. Implement this in the CLI layer only: do NOT modify core.py. Keep the existing tests passing (python3 -m pytest).
